vision: Seed and nurture creativity, innovation, fostering a culture of entrepreneurship, vicinity, work solutions and facilitating students of ours, as well as other institutions in collaboratively, cooperatively on complex problems, providing technology transfer for sustainable societal development.

Collaborate with stakeholders including ATAL Tinkering Labs, School Innovation Councils, work collectively and cooperatively, building an innovative and enterprising ecosystem.
